sequence_points.name: Cityscape with Tall Buildings
sequence_points.description: A vertical painting depicting a dense urban skyline with tall, slender buildings under a muted sky. The composition emphasizes height and architectural form, rendered in cool tones of gray and blue.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Interior Scene
sequence_points.description: A small, vertically oriented painting depicting an abstracted interior space with muted blues and grays, featuring indistinct architectural elements such as a doorway or window. The artwork is mounted on a plain white wall, centered within the frame.
